title: Toddler Standing in Baby Walker, 1956 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot from October 1956 capturing a smiling toddler standing up inside a vintage metal baby walker outside in a suburban backyard or driveway next to a residential house. The top border features a photofinishing date stamp reading 'OCT • 56', reflecting everyday mid-20th-century family life and post-war American childhood.
